entry.summary: This event has been postponed and revised road closure dates will be announced when known. There will be restricted road access for Clyde Jeffery Drive, Westminster Avenue and Prebensen Drive on Saturday 12 November from 11am-11pm, due to the Hawke's Bay Craft Beer and Food Festival.
